Target files: omnigent/harnesses/hermes_native/bridge.py, omnigent/harnesses/hermes_native/forwarder.py, omnigent/inner/hermes_native_executor.py. A fresh Hermes session could lose its first message, reject an empty database created by Omnigent's observer, or receive duplicated text when delivery retried before persistence. Preserve config-version metadata, keep database observation read-only, and wait for both the session-store schema and nonc... (Ref: https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent/pull/13816)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] 命令组兜底的 LOCAL_IO_ERROR 信封没有 hints
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: 命令组兜底的 LOCAL_IO_ERROR 补上可执行指引. Target files: src/boss_agent_cli/main.py, tests/test_internal_error.py, CHANGELOG.md. 没有 `@handle_auth_errors` 的本地命令（`stats` / `cities` / `config set` 等）写文件失败时由 `BossCliGroup` 的 `except OSError` 出 `LOCAL_IO_ERROR`，但信封的 `hints` 一直是 `null`： (Ref: https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/boss-agent-cli/pull/1014)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] export / chat --export 的 -o 参数错误要等抓完平台数据才报
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: -o 参数错误在第一次平台请求之前暴露. Target files: pyproject.toml, src/boss_agent_cli/commands/_output_path.py, src/boss_agent_cli/commands/chat.py. `export` 与 `chat --export` 的 `-o` 路径在**抓完平台数据之后**才校验。用 mock 平台实测： (Ref: https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/boss-agent-cli/pull/1012)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] resume export 的失败信封一律指向浏览器内核，html/json 导出被误导
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: resume export 的失败信封按原因分流，不再一律指向浏览器内核. Target files: src/boss_agent_cli/commands/resume_cmd.py, tests/test_resume_export.py, CHANGELOG.md. `boss resume export` 没有统一的 `@handle_auth_errors` 装饰器，导出失败的三层全部落进同一个 `EXPORT_FAILED` +「检查 patchright 安装」。但 `--format html` / `json` 只用本地模板渲染与 `write_text`，完全不碰 patchright。 (Ref: https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/boss-agent-cli/pull/1010)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Hugging Face chat ignores HUGGINGFACE_API_BASE and fails on huggingface/tgi when the endpoint comes from the environment
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(huggingface): honor HUGGINGFACE_API_BASE and env endpoints for chat. Target files: litellm/llms/huggingface/chat/transformation.py, tests/unit/llms/huggingface/chat/test_huggingface_chat_transformation.py. If you point litellm at your own Hugging Face endpoint through `HUGGINGFACE_API_BASE`, chat requests go to the literal URL "None", and `huggingface/tgi` crashes with either env var set. This makes an endpoint from the environment behave the same as passing `api_base` directly. (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/51449)

workarounds.symptom: @langchain/core 1.1.46 breaks withStructuredOutput streaming for Anthropic models
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core,anthropic): restore withStructuredOutput on streamed Anthropic responses. Target files: libs/langchain-core/src/messages/base.ts, libs/providers/langchain-anthropic/src/output_parsers.ts, libs/langchain-core/src/messages/tests/base_message.test.ts. `ChatAnthropic.withStructuredOutput(...)` fails whenever the response is streamed. That includes `.stream()`, `.invoke()` under a streaming callback, and `.invoke()` under a chat model stream events handler, which is how agents run on LangGraph Platform. (Ref: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchainjs/pull/12230)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: 非登录命令不再把浏览器内核缺失报成可重试错误. Target files: src/boss_agent_cli/commands/_login_errors.py, src/boss_agent_cli/commands/me.py, src/boss_agent_cli/display.py. patchright 升级后，本机已安装的 Chromium 修订版与 `browsers.json` 声明不一致时，任何走浏览器通道的命令都会在启动阶段失败： (Ref: https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/boss-agent-cli/pull/1008)

workarounds.symptom: fix(stores): refuse a symlinked leaf in the remaining atomic writers (workspace registry, consolidation archive, runstore)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(stores): refuse a symlink planted at the leaf instead of replacing it. Target files: agentdescent/consolidation.py, agentdescent/filetree.py, agentdescent/runstore.py. `os.replace` does not follow the final symlink, so the four writers still renaming over a user-named leaf each wrote a fresh regular file over an operator's link: the link was gone, the outside target kept its bytes, and nothing was said. #1008/#1017/#1015 refuse this shape for the tree and fixture writers and #1029 for the shared surface helper;... (Ref: https://github.com/ThinkFlowLab/agentdescent/pull/1034)

workarounds.symptom: Breaking out of an async generator flow marks the run Failed after Completed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix early closure of async generator flows. Target files: src/prefect/flow_engine.py, tests/test_flow_engine.py. This PR fixes `AttributeError` when an async generator flow is closed early. It awaits the generator's cleanup while the flow context is active and preserves the completed run state. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23886)

workarounds.symptom: fix(cli): a SurfaceError prints as one line without the type prefix, like its sibling writers
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): print a SurfaceError as one error line, like the sibling writers. workarounds.symptom: Import prefect opens .env 216 times, which stalls on a 1Password Environments (FIFO) .env
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Read `.env` once per process when loading settings. Target files: src/prefect/settings/base.py, src/prefect/settings/sources.py, tests/test_settings.py. This PR makes `import prefect` open `./.env` one time instead of 216 times (FIFO) or 324 times (regular file). This stops the startup stall when `.env` is a 1Password Environments mount (a FIFO). (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23533)

workarounds.symptom: RRuleSchedule.from_rrule loses IANA timezone on Windows (falls back to UTC)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve IANA timezone when dateutil resolves via tzdata (Windows). Target files: src/prefect/client/schemas/schedules.py, tests/client/schemas/test_schedules.py. `_iana_timezone_name` identifies a `dateutil` tzfile by scanning its `_filename` for a `/zoneinfo/` path component. On Windows there is no system zoneinfo directory; `dateutil` resolves zones through the `tzdata` package and `_filename` is the bare IANA name (`America/New_York`), so the marker lookup missed and `RRuleSchedule.from_rrule` fell back to `"UTC"... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23295)

workarounds.symptom: Chat "send message" freeze on "repeat message"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(editor): Initialize chat WebSocket when reposting a message. Target files: packages/frontend/@n8n/chat/src/types/chat.ts, packages/frontend/@n8n/chat/src/__tests__/Input.spec.ts, packages/frontend/@n8n/chat/src/__tests__/MessageActions.spec.ts. With the Chat Trigger in **Using Response Nodes** mode, Reposting a user message started a new execution but did not connect the chat WebSocket. The Chat node reply never reached the client, so the chat stayed in the waiting state and looked frozen. (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/43593)
